trigger.description: Restore or preview an authenticated backup containing explicit code locators without complete canonical freshness history. Legacy trust-history v1/v2 carriers omit that history; v3 explicitly records a missing canonical source row. Recovery retains the locators with Suspect freshness.
setup_commands: # Select the original source workspace and an authenticated backup with explicit code locators but missing canonical anchor history.

expected_emission.repair_string: Recreate a private backup from the original workspace with a current binary to preserve code-anchor history; run an explicit drift check before treating recovered anchors as current.
